name: scalecart
description: ScaleCart monorepo: one folder per deployable service (apps/*) + small shared packages (packages/*)

scripts.build: npm run db:generate && tsc -b apps/gateway apps/identity apps/catalog apps/order apps/payment apps/inventory apps/notification apps/scalekv apps/scalelog
scripts.seed: npm run seed -w @scalecart/identity && npm run seed -w @scalecart/catalog
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:generate -w @scalecart/identity && npm run db:generate -w @scalecart/catalog && npm run db:generate -w @scalecart/order && npm run db:generate -w @scalecart/inventory && npm run db:generate -w @scalecart/payment && npm run db:generate -w @scalecart/notification
scripts.db:deploy: npm run db:deploy -w @scalecart/identity && npm run db:deploy -w @scalecart/catalog && npm run db:deploy -w @scalecart/inventory && npm run db:deploy -w @scalecart/payment && npm run db:deploy -w @scalecart/notification && npm run db:move-users-to-identity && npm run db:move-products-to-catalog && npm run db:deploy -w @scalecart/order
